RagShortTexts: The Iltan Supply Line transports cattle, sheep, and grain from Mount Iltan to the Empire.

Variants.Content: Where is Mount Iltan? No idea—sounds like a Khuzait mountain from the name.
Hey now, Mount Iltan is the border mountain between us and Sturgia!

Mount Iltan stands in the northeastern corner of the Calradian continent as the border mountain between the Khuzait and Sturgia. The famous Iltan Supply Line originates here, shipping a steady stream of cattle, sheep, and grain to the Empire.
